Document: # Rule 0 - The Golden Rule This is a ROLEPLAYING SERVER, where we expect a standard of story telling. Behaving in ways or attitudes that do not display consideration and thoughtfulness in some capacity may result in bans at admin discretion. You can appeal, of course, as admins are prone to mistakes as we're all human- but don't go around like a regular SS14 Clown throwing pies at people and then exploding them. That'd be nice.
